name: 81657 · Vail, CO
findings: ZIP 81657 (Vail) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81657 (Vail) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81657 (Vail) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
